tvdb.title: Trouble in Monster Strike
tvdb.synopsis: Oragon lived a lonely life all by himself, until one day he was pulled into a mysterious new dimension. There he learns that an incredibly powerful enemy will attack in six months, destroying his beloved Monster Strike forever! Now Oragon must gather allies in the Strike World to save Monster Strike!

episodes.synopsis: Oragon lived a lonely life all by himself, until one day he was pulled into a mysterious new dimension. There he learns that an incredibly powerful enemy will attack in six months, destroying his beloved Monster Strike forever! Now Oragon must gather allies in the Strike World to save Monster Strike!

episodes.title: Angelic Grace, Demonic Counsel
episodes.synopsis: Balt places a curse over all of Lecillia, then disappears along with the Orb. Solomon and Levy both work in their own ways to lift the curse, but...

episodes.title: Dark Machinations
episodes.synopsis: Those saps are goners. With Forneus and Cassiel, Solomon seeks out Balt to save her people. Along the way however, Forneus senses that Lecillia is in danger...

episodes.title: Unwavering Resolve
episodes.synopsis:
Solomon and Levy have successfully held off the Great Sands' invasion on Lecillia.
But an even greater threat draws near...

episodes.title: Conviction and Tears
episodes.synopsis:
Solomon has been taken captive by the Scyzari Empire. 
The guilt of endangering Lecillia weighs heavily on Levy's heart. 
What does fate have in store for these two daughters of Lecillia...

episodes.title: Passing of the Torch
episodes.synopsis: - Promise me that you will protect the smiles of the people. - Many moons ago, Malkuth, newly-risen emperor of Scyzari, called for an audience with the First King of Lecillia. Not even the king, however, could have imaged Malkuth's dreadful intentions, or the harrowing events that young Solomon would witness...

episodes.title: Rising Above
episodes.synopsis:
- If it would save my people... my life's a small price to pay! -
Solomon resolves to save her people, even if it means giving up her life. 
Meanwhile, Balt attempts to access the forbidden book of demons...

episodes.title: Awakening
episodes.synopsis:
- The light of Lecillia will not be snuffed out... -
Levy stands face-to-face with her father's murderer, 
Malkuth. Does her ice magic stand a chance against this mighty foe?

episodes.title: Transcendence
episodes.synopsis:
- I won't let you get away with this! -
Solomon's newly-awakened power summons forth Forneus' true form.
In a grand display of his power, the Great Marquis of the Netherworld tries to stop Malkuth, however...

episodes.title: One in Heart and Mind
episodes.synopsis:
Solomon and Levy finally unite to protect their beloved people. 
The final battle against the now almighty Malkuth is at hand...

episodes.title: The Beguiled
episodes.synopsis:
Arthur faces her fellow pupil Arawin in battle, but something inside him has changed after all these years. 
What can Arthur do to stand against his blood-lust and magic blade...?!

episodes.title: The Knights Strike Back
episodes.synopsis:
The fearsome Decemvir Tiphereth would even block out the sun with a disco ball in the name of beauty. Arthur's group returns to Britannia,
but can they save her neon-coated friends and people...?

episodes.title: A Radiant World
episodes.synopsis:
Arthur confronts Tiphereth's true form. With her country and life on the line, 
she stands firm in a heated battle against the Decemvir's enhanced strength.
Who will come out on top of their intense battle...?

episodes.title: A Dying World
episodes.synopsis: On a world where nearly all life has been wiped out, a young man named Noah gathers Orb Fragments to power his ark, dreaming of one day escaping the planet with its surviving animals. One day, some strange life forms fall from the sky! Who—or what—could they be...?!

episodes.title: My First Friends
episodes.synopsis:
After setting off in search of a giant Orb, Noah and the others are attacked by a strange creature called an Adaptor. 
The group manages to defeat the beast and later spends the night in a deserted town. 
There Noah reveals the origins of his mechanical body,just before they face a terrible new foe...!

episodes.title: Pact`s Conclusion
episodes.synopsis:
Noah's group discovers an enormous Orb, but it's deep inside an Adaptor nest! 
Chesed makes a pinky swear with Noah before going off on his own to collect the Orb's energy. However...

related.plot: Dall'omonimo gioco di ruolo per cellulari Monster Strike, nasce la trasposizione animata. La serie è stata ufficialmente annunciata da Hiroki Morita, presidente del Mixi Inc, l’azienda produttrice del videogioco. La notizia è stata divulgata attraverso i social network, dopo l’autorizzazione per la messa in onda del primo episodio. L’uscita dell’Anime farà da trampolino di lancio per la nuove versione per le piattaforme Nintendo 3DS, che dovrebbe essere disponibile entro la fine dell’anno. Per il momento non ci sono ancora informazioni riguardo la trama e i successivi progetti.

related.title: Strike World: Deadverse Reloaded the Anime
related.plot:
Rinne è una ragazza che non riesce a vedere i volti delle altre persone. Nata in una famiglia il cui lavoro è quello di esorcizzare esseri soprannaturali, parte per la sua prima missione, ma incontra un nemico di natura diversa da quella che si aspettava e si ritrova in pericolo.

Dopo essere stata salvata da un uomo misterioso di nome Jugemu, Rinne scopre che tutti i mondi, compreso quello in cui vive, noto come “Strike Worlds”, sono in pericolo.

Mentre viaggia attraverso una serie di mondi in via di estinzione con Jugemu, la ragazza stringe un legame con lui...

Tradotto con DeepL.com (versione gratuita)

related.title: Monster Strike Anime
related.plot: Seguito di Monster Strike I mostri sono una presenza fissa quotidiana ormai. Ren, Aoi, Akira e Minami si sono presi la responsabilità  di ripulire il vicinato dai mostri violenti. I giorni passano, finché uno studente si trasferisce dall'America nella loro classe: Mana Livingston. Mana diventa subito amica del gruppo, il cui legame si fortifica grazie ai loro mostri. Ma un'ombra si annida nell'oscurità , un messaggero del pericolo in arrivo.
